title: Wingman AV Product Semantics Registry
purpose: Canonical first-contact AV product understanding. Wingman must classify what a product is, what practical job it performs, its topology, logical I/O, physical connector types, output behaviour, transport, specialist capabilities and dependencies before attempting a WyreStorm match.
nonNegotiableRules: Purpose and topology are classified before SKU similarity or brand matching.
Connector type is not product purpose: HDMI, USB-C, HDBaseT, Ethernet, fibre, XLR and Phoenix describe interfaces/transport, not the job of the product.
Logical I/O and physical connectors are separate facts.
Mirrored outputs are functional fan-out for distribution amplifiers, but do not increase routed matrix size.
A matrix output is independently routable; a mirrored output repeats the same selected source; a loop/local-monitor output is a convenience copy.
Multiview means multiple simultaneous source windows on one output canvas; multiple outputs alone do not imply multiview.
AV-over-IP role is directional: encoder/transmitter, decoder/receiver, or transceiver. Role is a hard comparison gate.
A bridge/converter is compared by what it converts from and to, not by a shared connector keyword.
Support/accessory products cannot lead a replacement unless the competitor item is itself a support/accessory product.
Unknown facts remain unknown. Missing evidence triggers research/review, never invention.

identity.name: string
identity.direction: source-side | destination-side | bidirectional | processing | room-core | support | unknown

ports.connector: HDMI | USB-C | USB-A | USB-B | HDBaseT | RJ45/Ethernet | fibre/SFP | SDI | DP | DVI | VGA | XLR | Phoenix | RCA | 3.5mm | TOSLINK | other
ports.signalFamily: video | audio | usb-data | network-av | network-audio | control | power | mixed
ports.logicalFunction: source-input | routed-output | mirrored-output | loop-output | monitor-output | host-port | device-port | network-stream | control | power | other

point-to-point.definition: One source-side endpoint or device path connects to one destination-side endpoint.
point-to-point.keyQuestion: What travels across the link, in which direction, how far, and what peer endpoint is required?

one-to-many-mirrored.definition: One selected source is duplicated to multiple outputs that all carry the same content.
one-to-many-mirrored.keyQuestion: How many mirrored outputs exist and what connector/format does each use?

many-to-one-selected.definition: Several source inputs exist, with one selected for a destination at a time.
many-to-one-selected.keyQuestion: How many source choices exist and what destination/output workflow is required?

many-to-many-routed.definition: Multiple inputs can be independently routed to multiple logical outputs.
many-to-many-routed.keyQuestion: What is the true routed matrix size, excluding mirrored/local/loop connectors?

many-to-one-composited.definition: Multiple sources are simultaneously arranged as windows on one output canvas.
many-to-one-composited.keyQuestion: How many simultaneous windows and how many independent canvases are supported?

canvas-to-many.definition: One or more sources are processed across a coordinated multi-display canvas.
canvas-to-many.keyQuestion: What wall/canvas geometry, window count and scaling behaviour are required?

network-routed.definition: Media is encoded/published and subscribed/decoded across an Ethernet/fibre network.
network-routed.keyQuestion: What network class, codec, direction, latency and ecosystem requirements apply?

bridge.definition: The product translates, combines or exposes one signal/workflow ecosystem to another.
bridge.keyQuestion: What enters, what leaves, and what translation/processing happens between them?

room-core.definition: A product combines several room functions such as switching, USB, wireless, audio, scaling and control.
room-core.keyQuestion: What room workflow does the combined feature set enable?

endpoint-source.definition: A device creates or injects media into the system.
endpoint-source.keyQuestion: What media does it create and through which output interfaces?

endpoint-destination.definition: A device consumes/receives media from the system.
endpoint-destination.keyQuestion: What media does it receive and through which input interfaces?

bidirectional-endpoint.definition: The product can be configured for source-side or destination-side operation.
bidirectional-endpoint.keyQuestion: What mode is required in this application?

support-only.definition: The product supports a system but is not itself the principal AV function.
support-only.keyQuestion: Is the competitor item also a support item, or is this only a dependency?

rules: Direction is product-specific.
An HDMI output may be routed, mirrored, loop-through or local-monitor; output behaviour must be stored separately.
Do not infer video merely from the presence of USB-C.
Record host/device behaviour, Alt Mode direction and PD separately.
Usually host-facing in AV products, but verify host/device role.
Usually upstream/device-facing in AV products, but verify host/device role.
TX/source-side and RX/destination-side roles are distinct.
Generation, distance, USB, power and interoperability are independent facts.
An HDBaseT connector on a matrix may be a routed output; on an extender TX it is transport output.
RJ45 alone does not establish AV-over-IP.
Record protocol/network class separately.
SFP/fibre does not establish protocol or direction by itself.
Record 3G/6G/12G generation separately.
MST logical display count is not the same as physical connector count.
Record input/output and mic/line/digital function explicitly.
Connector form alone says nothing about signal family; labelled function is mandatory.
Record signal type and direction explicitly.
Record direction explicitly.
Store transmit and receive channel counts separately where known.
Record pass-through versus local device-control behaviour where relevant.
Identify emitter/TX and receiver/RX function.
Record electrical direction/rating separately.

productArchetypes.name: Distribution amplifier / splitter
productArchetypes.purpose: Duplicate one source to multiple destinations without independent routing.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Same source on several displays.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Normally one primary video input; identify connector and supported signal format.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Two or more physical outputs carrying the same source; mirrored outputs are functional fan-out.
cautions: Do not treat mirrored outputs as matrix routes.

productArchetypes.name: Basic switcher
productArchetypes.purpose: Select one of several inputs for one destination path.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Simple source selection for one display/output path.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Usually one selected output; extra identical outputs may be mirrored.

productArchetypes.name: Matrix switcher
productArchetypes.purpose: Independently route multiple inputs to multiple logical outputs.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Different sources to different displays/zones simultaneously.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Multiple source inputs; record connector family and quantity.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Multiple independently routable logical outputs; mirrored/local/loop outputs are separate.
cautions: Physical output connector count is not automatically matrix size.

productArchetypes.name: Seamless matrix
productArchetypes.purpose: Matrix routing with frame-sync/scaling for presentation-safe transitions.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Multi-output presentation/control rooms needing clean switching.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Multiple source inputs, often mixed connector types.

productArchetypes.name: Presentation switcher / room core
productArchetypes.purpose: Combine room source switching with USB-C, wireless, scaling, USB/audio/control workflows.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Meeting rooms/classrooms where user workflow matters as much as I/O.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Several local source inputs; USB-C may combine video, USB data and charging.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: One or a few display outputs; determine whether outputs are mirrored or independent.

productArchetypes.name: Multiview processor
productArchetypes.purpose: Show multiple simultaneous source windows on one output canvas.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Monitoring, confidence displays, command/control and multi-source presentation.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: One or more canvases; source windows are not separate physical outputs.
cautions: Multiple outputs alone never prove multiview.

productArchetypes.name: Video wall processor
productArchetypes.purpose: Map/process source content across multiple displays as a coordinated canvas.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: LCD/LED walls requiring bezel, layout, window or canvas control.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Multiple display/wall outputs or network-fed wall endpoints.

productArchetypes.name: Scaler / format converter
productArchetypes.purpose: Convert connector/format/timing and optionally scale video.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Resolve incompatible source/destination formats or timings.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Converted/scaled outputs; usually not independently routed unless explicitly stated.

productArchetypes.name: HDBaseT extender kit
productArchetypes.purpose: Extend AV/control/USB over twisted pair between source and destination.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Longer-than-HDMI source-to-display paths.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: TX accepts local sources; RX-side return USB/control may exist.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: TX outputs HDBaseT; RX exposes local HDMI/USB/audio/control.

productArchetypes.name: HDBaseT transmitter
productArchetypes.purpose: Send local source signals onto an HDBaseT link.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Source-side wall plate or box transmitter.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: HDBaseT transport output; local HDMI loop if present is not a second routed zone.

productArchetypes.name: HDBaseT receiver
productArchetypes.purpose: Receive HDBaseT and expose local destination interfaces.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Display/device-side termination of HDBaseT.

productArchetypes.name: USB extender
productArchetypes.purpose: Extend USB host/device connectivity over copper, fibre or network.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Remote cameras, touchscreens, speakerphones, storage or KVM peripherals.

productArchetypes.name: KVM extender
productArchetypes.purpose: Extend computer video plus keyboard/mouse/USB control.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Remote PCs, control rooms, machine rooms.

productArchetypes.name: AV-over-IP encoder
productArchetypes.purpose: Convert local media into a network stream.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Source-side endpoint in distributed AVoIP.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Ethernet/fibre network stream; local monitor/loop is separate and usually mirrored.

productArchetypes.name: AV-over-IP decoder
productArchetypes.purpose: Receive a network media stream and expose it locally.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Display-side endpoint in distributed AVoIP.

productArchetypes.name: AV-over-IP transceiver
productArchetypes.purpose: Operate as encoder or decoder according to configuration.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Common endpoint hardware used source-side or display-side.

productArchetypes.name: AV-over-IP controller
productArchetypes.purpose: Discover/configure/control/rout AVoIP endpoints.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Management dependency for an AVoIP system.

productArchetypes.name: Managed AV network switch
productArchetypes.purpose: Provide Ethernet switching for AVoIP, Dante, NDI and control.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Network infrastructure rather than endpoint replacement.

productArchetypes.name: Wireless presentation hub
productArchetypes.purpose: Receive wireless sharing sessions and present them to a room display, often with wired/USB features.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Guest presentation/collaboration rooms.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Display output; USB conference bridge may be bidirectional logically.

productArchetypes.name: Casting dongle / button
productArchetypes.purpose: User-side accessory that initiates a wireless presentation session to a compatible room core.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Laptop-side accessory, not the complete room receiver.

productArchetypes.name: UC video bar
productArchetypes.purpose: Combine camera, microphones, speaker and host meeting workflow.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: All-in-one small/medium meeting room conferencing.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: USB/network host plus optional content inputs.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Camera/audio to host and speaker output; optional display/content output.

productArchetypes.name: Camera / USB bridge
productArchetypes.purpose: Bridge professional camera/media inputs into USB conferencing or another media ecosystem.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Make HDMI/SDI/NDI cameras appear as USB conference devices or combine multiple cameras.

productArchetypes.name: PTZ camera
productArchetypes.purpose: Capture controllable room video.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Conferencing, lecture capture, streaming, production.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Control/network/power/audio inputs are auxiliary, not programme-video source inputs.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: USB/HDMI/SDI/NDI/IP video outputs depending on model.

productArchetypes.name: NDI camera
productArchetypes.purpose: Capture video and publish NDI network media.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Network-native camera source.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: NDI plus any local HDMI/SDI/USB outputs.
cautions: NDI support on a bridge/decoder does not make it a camera.

productArchetypes.name: Fixed conference/capture camera
productArchetypes.purpose: Capture room video without motorised PTZ.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Huddle rooms, fixed framing, document/capture positions.

productArchetypes.name: Capture / recorder / streamer
productArchetypes.purpose: Acquire media for recording, streaming or computer ingest.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Lecture capture, streaming, recording, HDMI/SDI-to-USB ingest.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: USB capture, encoded IP stream, storage and/or confidence output.

productArchetypes.name: Audio DSP
productArchetypes.purpose: Mix, route and process audio channels.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Microphones, conferencing, reinforcement and room audio processing.

productArchetypes.name: Audio mixer
productArchetypes.purpose: Combine and route multiple audio sources.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Live/event/room audio source management.

productArchetypes.name: Power amplifier
productArchetypes.purpose: Raise line/network audio to speaker-level power.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Drive passive loudspeakers.

productArchetypes.name: Network audio interface
productArchetypes.purpose: Bridge local audio channels to/from network audio.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Join analogue/digital sources and destinations to Dante/AES67.

productArchetypes.name: Audio embedder / de-embedder
productArchetypes.purpose: Insert or extract audio from a video transport.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Break audio into/out of HDMI/SDI/AV paths.

productArchetypes.name: Microphone
productArchetypes.purpose: Capture acoustic audio.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Speech/music capture.
productArchetypes.inputSemantics: Acoustic field plus power/control/network depending on design.

productArchetypes.name: Loudspeaker
productArchetypes.purpose: Convert electrical/network audio to acoustic output.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Room audio reproduction.

productArchetypes.name: Control processor
productArchetypes.purpose: Run automation logic and control AV/environmental devices.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: System automation/control brain.

productArchetypes.name: Touch panel
productArchetypes.purpose: Provide a user interface to a control/room system.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Room/user UI.

productArchetypes.name: GPIO / relay interface
productArchetypes.purpose: Expose contact closure, GPIO or relay automation I/O.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Screens, lifts, sensors, triggers and simple automation.

productArchetypes.name: Display / monitor
productArchetypes.purpose: Present video to viewers.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Visual destination.
productArchetypes.outputSemantics: Normally no programme-video output; loops do not create new zones.

productArchetypes.name: Projector
productArchetypes.purpose: Project video onto a screen/surface.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Large-format room display.

productArchetypes.name: LED display processor
productArchetypes.purpose: Map/scale/process source content onto an LED canvas.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: LED display infrastructure.

productArchetypes.name: Cable / passive adapter
productArchetypes.purpose: Physically connect compatible interfaces without being the system's main AV function.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Dependency/accessory.

productArchetypes.name: Power supply / injector / PDU
productArchetypes.purpose: Provide/distribute power.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: System dependency.

productArchetypes.name: Mount / bracket / rack accessory
productArchetypes.purpose: Mechanically install another product.
productArchetypes.practicalUse: Physical installation support.

firstContactProcedure.name: Identify the practical job
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Describe the product in plain AV terms before reading candidate SKUs: source, destination, router, processor, bridge, room core, endpoint or support item.

firstContactProcedure.name: Assign a topology model
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Determine point-to-point, mirrored distribution, switched, routed matrix, composited multiview, wall/canvas, network-routed, bridge, room-core or endpoint behaviour.

firstContactProcedure.name: Separate logical I/O from connectors
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Count logical inputs/outputs and then map physical connectors to those functions. Do not let connector count redefine topology.

firstContactProcedure.name: Classify every output behaviour
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Mark each output/routed group as routed, mirrored, loop, local-monitor, composited, encoded/network or destination/local.

firstContactProcedure.name: Resolve transport and role
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Identify HDMI/local, USB-C, HDBaseT/proprietary twisted pair, fibre, SDI, Ethernet AVoIP, NDI, wireless or network-audio; then identify direction/role.

firstContactProcedure.name: Extract specialist capabilities
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Record only evidence-backed features that change practical equivalence: scaling, seamless switching, multiview, wall, USB/KVM, Dante/AES67, AEC, PTZ/tracking, BYOM, power, control, redundancy.

firstContactProcedure.name: Create the comparison contract
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Separate mandatory, preferred, informational and unknown facts. Hard-gate purpose/topology/role before scoring feature similarity.

firstContactProcedure.name: Research unknowns if necessary
firstContactProcedure.instruction: Use manufacturer evidence to fill missing semantic facts. Do not treat a discovered product page as sufficient unless it establishes the required comparison contract.

hardMismatchExamples.reason: Different topology: mirrored distribution vs independent routing.
